I ran the numbers on your DCA plan for DOCN versus SPY over that 12-month window. You’d be putting in $100 every month, so 12 purchases total, with 10 basis points in fees and 5 basis points in slippage baked into each trade.

The effective amount you actually invest each month is $100 × (1 – 0.001 – 0.0005) = $98.95.
